verdict.rationale: Morph's docs include a dedicated Batch component page stating you can 'run thousands of chat completions offline at half price', which is a documented 50% discount on asynchronous batch inference compared with real-time pricing. The evidence is a single line, so how jobs are submitted and tracked is not shown. Missing for 10: details of the job submission, polling and result-retrieval workflow, turnaround or SLA terms, which models are eligible, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
